tasks.short: Teach socially acceptable behavior with teacher-directed techniques

steps.what: Read the actual teacher-directed behavior targets and reinforcement instructions
Teach socially acceptable behavior using the specified positive reinforcement or modification techniques

tasks.design: Retain reading of the teacher's actual approach in {DOCS} or {LMS} and direct behavior teaching. Native plan access already supplies the instructions in this encounter; no template replaces timely, context-sensitive reinforcement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teaching behavior depends on the pupil's actual actions and appropriate immediate response.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared plans support consistency but establish no removable repeated operation here.
tasks.still_hard: Applying the teacher's approach consistently without misreading a child's needs.
tasks.human_edge: Respond sensitively and recognise when the teacher needs to reassess the approach.
tasks.altitude: No change to teacher-directed behavior support.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: positive reinforcement and behavior teaching require direct, contextual interaction; a separate behavior log is not inherent to every teaching encounter.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is reading an existing teacher-directed approach and teaching behavior. The teacher's plan production remains their existing role work, not free new assistant preparation. Actual assistant reading stays counted.

Before zero, inspect plan lookup, prompt-material preparation, behavior tallies, required notes and teacher/parent sends. This encounter already has direct instructions and establishes no separately required assistant-owned written output. If the actual protocol requires data capture, add and assess that existing record once before using zero for the broader workflow.
Native access is assessed first. No repetitive navigation baseline, new behavior log, transcript or automatic pupil inference is introduced. No implementation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual teacher-required behavior tallies or written feedback
research_questions: Observe the behavior protocol and identify actual tally, material-preparation or communication duties.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 20 instruction-reading and 80 behavior-teaching points. A pupil needing a different response still requires full contextual understanding; no established duplicate record or material-authoring operation is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise pupils in school settings and on field trips

steps.what: Review actual supervision responsibilities, pupil needs and field-trip instructions when applicable
Supervise pupils in classrooms, halls, cafeterias, yards, gymnasiums or field trips

tasks.design: Retain actual supervision and separately counted instruction reading in {DOCS}. Native access already provides the duty information here; protecting pupils still requires the assistant's physical observation and response.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision depends on continuous awareness of the actual pupils and setting.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing instructions support preparation without replacing physical supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising hazards and responding quickly to individual support needs.
tasks.human_edge: Act immediately when a pupil needs help or a situation becomes unsafe.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supervising pupils with disabilities requires direct observation and physical response; an activity log is not inherent to routine supervision.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a routine supervision period. Existing duty owners supply responsibilities and pupil needs; assistant reading remains counted. Trip organization and permission collection are not silently included or transferred free.

Before zero, inspect roster checks, headcounts, trip forms, incident reports and sends. Live checks remain within supervision; this routine period establishes no separate written output. Add any actual trip paperwork or incident report as its own assessed work when present.
Native instructions are assessed first and already direct. No new supervision log, monitoring system or pupil score is introduced. No implementation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual trip forms, roster-entry or incident-report duties
research_questions: Observe supervision and identify any actual record entry or trip preparation beyond live checks.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 10 instruction-reading and 90 supervision points. A field setting with greater uncertainty still needs full live checks and observation; no actual duplicate entry or report is established to remove.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Tutor pupils to master assignments and reinforce concepts

steps.what: Read the actual assignment, teacher's concept guidance and relevant pupil work
Tutor children individually or in small groups to reinforce teacher-presented concepts
Discuss actual pupil difficulties with the classroom teacher

tasks.design: Retain actual assignment review in {LMS} and {DOCS}, direct tutoring and discussion with the teacher. Native materials already provide the assigned content here; the assistant still has to understand the child's work and respond personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reinforcing concepts depends on the pupil's actual understanding and practice.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared assignments support preparation without establishing a new removable operation.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing an appropriate explanation within the teacher's guidance.
tasks.human_edge: Notice confusion and adjust support without completing the assignment for the child.
tasks.altitude: No change to teacher-directed tutoring responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: tutoring pupils with disabilities requires actual work review, responsive practice and communication with the responsible teacher.

assumptions: Provisional encounter uses existing teacher-assigned material and oral feedback. Teacher content creation remains separately owned existing work, while all assistant preparation and interaction are retained.

Before zero, inspect material lookup, adapted worksheet creation, written observations, marks and teacher messages. Native access is direct; no separate required written output is established here. Add any actual adaptation or record entry once in its proper workflow, and separately gate a real send, before estimating the broader task.
No new tutoring log, pupil score or recording duty is introduced. No repeated search baseline is assumed; no implementation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual adapted-material or written feedback requirements
research_questions: Observe tutoring and separate real worksheet creation, record entry and messages from personal help.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 15 assignment-review, 75 tutoring and 10 teacher-discussion points. An unfamiliar concept still requires full understanding and personal support; no established duplicate record or required adapted-material operation is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Use specialist instructional strategies for pupil development

steps.what: Review teacher-selected sensory, language, cognition or memory strategy instructions
Arrange the actual existing sensory or instructional aids for pupil access
Employ special educational techniques during actual sensory, language, cognition or memory instruction

tasks.design: Retain reading of actual specialist instructions in {DOCS} and {LMS}, physical aid arrangement and direct technique use. Native access already provides the teacher-selected approach; no generated intervention or automated pupil assessment is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specialist strategies must be understood and applied to the actual pupil and setting.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared instructions and aids support preparation but establish no removable repeated operation here.
tasks.still_hard: Applying techniques sensitively and recognising when they are unsuitable or ineffective.
tasks.human_edge: Respond to the child's access needs and seek teacher guidance when needed.
tasks.altitude: No change to teacher-directed specialist instruction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: using specialist instructional techniques requires understanding, physical preparation and context-sensitive interaction; digital instructions alone do not perform that work.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is applying an existing teacher-selected strategy with existing aids. Strategy design and original aid creation remain existing separately owned work, not free new assistant work; the assistant's reading and physical arrangement stay counted.

Before zero, inspect reference lookup, aid authoring, device configuration, observation records and teacher messages. Native instructions are directly available and this scenario establishes no separate new file or record duty. Add actual authoring, settings entry or required observation capture before estimating that different workflow.
No new progress log, transcript, pupil score or emotion inference is introduced. No recurring automation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual assistant-owned aid authoring, device settings or record duties
research_questions: Observe specialist instruction and identify actual repeated settings, material creation and required records.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 20 strategy-reading, 10 physical aid-arrangement and 70 specialist-instruction points. A new sensory access need still requires full contextual preparation; no established duplicate entry or material-authoring operation is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain teacher-directed behavior support, supervision, tutoring and specialist instructional practice.
skills_to_grow: Recognising when to seek teacher guidance
role.ambitious_version: No autonomous teaching decisions or new pupil-record requirement is proposed.
